trails.name: Chalets de Salvadon
trails.note: Runs 1.6 of 5.5 km inside the Sixt-Passy national nature reserve, where dogs are banned even on a lead (Décret 2019-1218, art. 5-III).

trails.name: Alpage de Commune
trails.note: Runs 2.7 of 5.6 km inside the Sixt-Passy national nature reserve, where dogs are banned even on a lead (Décret 2019-1218, art. 5-III).

trails.name: Rundweg Rotwand
trails.note: A 930 m one-way connecting path (route 8A) between two tracks in Altrei, inside Naturpark Trudner Horn.

trails.name: GEOWeg - Sentiero GEOlogico
trails.note: Goes down into the Bletterbach gorge on iron stairs and ladders, where the park operator requires a helmet. Not a walk for dogs.

trails.name: Giro del Zimon
trails.note: SAT path 392, graded EE (expert hikers only), on granite at 2,280–2,510 m, starting at a 2,500 m pass hours from any road. Not a walk for dogs.
